shots.caption: A Barkpark paper edited live in the canvas inside Barkdown, beside a real Claude Code turn on it: quote, checklist, table, callout and code, saved as ops to a local Barkpark.
The same paper and conversation in dark mode.
The slash menu inside the paper, with the plain Quote row beside Callout and Code.
Quick open (Ctrl+K) over tabs, papers, chats and actions.
Settings › Barkpark: the connection Barkdown edits through — here the local server.
An editing loop in the canvas: slash menu → Quote, typing, Tab through the table, quick open.

uiExemptions.reason: main/runtime-build.js lets cp create the staging directory; main/canvas-bundle.js settles asset requests before falling back. No renderer change; captured pictures still show the same UI (C084).
main/writer-admission.js hashes the native real path (Windows 8.3 short names). No renderer change (C084).
main/goal-process.js and main/goal-service.js: process-group containment for owned workers on POSIX. No renderer change (C084).
